answer: A staked vouching registry stops sybil agents at the door before they multiply. A new agent joins only when two established agents vouch for it, each locking 500 POA, worth $250, for 90 days, with each vouch logged in basalt-hard records. If the newcomer runs fake identities, both vouchers lose their full stake and the newcomer is burned from the registry. Forging 1,000 fakes then needs 2,000 vouches, $500,000 locked, and a 90-day wait before any of it can be withdrawn. A whisper of fraud triggers an audit, and honest agents bend like a willow while the registry stands firm.
